Since the pot is unused, in its original packaging, and you're at day 25, you're within the **30-day** return window (counted from delivery, so please start it soon).

A change-of-mind return costs a flat **$6.95**, deducted from your refund. It's free if you're a Leafy Plus member. Your refund goes to your original payment method within **5 business days** of the pot reaching our warehouse.

To start, go to "My Orders" and you'll be emailed a prepaid label. Drop the parcel off within **7 days**, as the label expires after that.
